mLocKeys.keySummary: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units as well as stunning anyone directly hit and blinding surrounding units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Heimerdinger tosses a grenade, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemy units and <status>Blinding</status> them for @BlindDuration@ seconds.  Enemies who are directly hit are <status>Stunned</status> for 1.5 seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>UPGRADE Slow!!</titleLeft><mainText>This turret is firing movement slowing shots.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Passive / Active: Passively increases Cooldown Reduction.  Activate to heal all active Evolution Turrets and cause them to fire frost shots, which reduce Movement Speed, for a short time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: @CooldownBonus*-100@% Cooldown Reduction.

Active: Empower all abilities and turrets for the duration.

Evolution Turrets: All turrets are healed for 100% of their maximum health and each attack applies a @MovementSpeedMod*-100@% Slow.
Hextech Micro-Rockets: Fire 5 rockets instead of 3.
CH-1 Concussion Grenade: Travels 33% faster.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Heimerdinger lays down a machine gun turret. Turrets gain abilities as this skill is increased. (Turrets deal half damage to towers).
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Heimerdinger constructs a Machine Gun Turret that deals @BonusDamage@ magic damage per attack. This ability has @MaxAmmo@ charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Each rank of this skill grants a further enhancement:
Rank 2: Turret attacks reduce the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 1 (max 50)
Rank 3: Maximum turrets increased to 2
Rank 4: Turrets gain an additional 125 Health
Rank 5: Turret attacks deal area damage
